overview_description.description: Dover offers an applicant tracking system that utilizes artificial intelligence to score resumes and manage the recruitment lifecycle. Its technical toolkit includes extensions for candidate sourcing, automated job board distribution, and systems for tracking employee referrals. The software streamlines administrative tasks such as email outreach and interview scheduling to reduce the operational burden on hiring managers. Additionally, a dedicated portal allows companies to monitor candidate submissions and costs from external recruiting agencies.
